observation.visible_scene: A dance/fitness studio with a full mirrored wall, a horizontal ballet barre, and a wooden plank floor. A man wearing a black sleeveless shirt and pink graffiti-print 'ZUMBA' shorts stands with his back to the camera, facing the mirror. The mirror reflects him front-on (black shirt with a red heart, glasses) plus a row of class members (mostly women in casual/athletic wear) standing in the room behind the camera line, all facing the mirror.
visible_changes: At the start (frames 1-2) the man stands still, feet together, arms hanging at his sides.
From frame 3 he lifts his right heel off the floor and bends his elbows, then (frames 5-7) raises both hands up toward/around his head while the right foot stays lifted behind him.
In frames 8-13 he steps the right foot out so the legs are apart and holds both arms raised above shoulder/head level, palms forward.
In frames 14-18 he lowers his arms back down to his sides while keeping the legs apart, lifting the left foot slightly.
In frames 19-27 he brings his feet back together and stands with hands resting near his hips, body roughly still.
In frames 28-30 he shifts his weight and rotates his torso slightly to the right, taking a small step with the left foot.
In frames 31-38 he raises both arms again up to head/overhead level with the legs apart, then in frames 39-41 brings the arms out horizontally to the sides at shoulder height, palms forward.

Throughout, the reflected class members and the reflected front-view of the man show their own arm movements (raising, extending outward) that roughly track the same exercise, indicating a group routine.
The man's position on the floor drifts laterally (his feet move from left-of-center toward right-of-center and back), i.e. he steps side-to-side across the floor rather than staying in one spot.
outside_clip_unknowns: The audio/music driving the routine and whether the movements form a repeating loop.
What the man does before frame 1 and after frame 41 (the excerpt starts mid-stance and ends mid-pose).
The exact choreography name or counts.
uncertain_details: Whether the slight change in framing of the mirror/panel edges is a small camera pan or purely the subject's lateral translation; the background is mostly static so camera motion is uncertain.
The precise footwork (step vs. tap vs. weight shift) is hard to resolve at this frame rate.
The reflected people are mirror images of individuals standing in the room, not separate physical objects behind the mirror.
